question: Could you analyze our data and identify which ten-year period starting from any movie release year present in the data had the largest number of films, considering consecutive ten-year periods beginning at each unique year? Only output the start year and the total count for that specific period.
sql:
WITH yearly_counts AS (
  SELECT TRY_CAST(year AS INTEGER) as clean_year, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM Movie
  GROUP BY clean_year
),
all_start_years AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT clean_year as start_year
  FROM yearly_counts
),
period_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    a.start_year,
    SUM(COALESCE(y.cnt, 0)) as total_films
  FROM all_start_years a
  LEFT JOIN yearly_counts y ON y.clean_year >= a.start_year AND y.clean_year < a.start_year + 10
  GROUP BY a.start_year
)
SELECT start_year, total_films
FROM period_counts
ORDER BY total_films DESC
LIMIT 1
